theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라

theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들

theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역

top_news.title: India Studies Tax Proposals to Encourage Stock Trading, Curb Speculative Bets
top_news.summary: Investors and economists have proposed raising taxes on stock derivatives while lowering levies on share trading.

top_news.title: China Markets $2 Billion of Dollar Bonds as Xi, Trump Meet
top_news.summary: China began marketing up to $2 billion of dollar-denominated sovereign bonds, as leaders of the world’s two largest economies are set to meet in Shenzhen.

top_news.title: Stocks Lose Momentum After Anthropic, Copper Gains: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks struggled to sustain gains for a second straight session as lingering concerns over the artificial-intelligence trade tempered initial enthusiasm over Anthropic PBC’s IPO pricing.

top_news.title: K-Pop Giants Position for China Return After Decade-Long Freeze
top_news.summary: South Korean entertainment companies are positioning themselves for a return to China after the two countries agreed to expand cultural exchanges, raising hopes that Beijing may loosen restrictions that have kept major K-pop acts out of the mainland for almost a decade.

top_news.title: A-Cap Insurer Asks to Defer Payouts to Clients Amid Deal Talks
top_news.summary: Advantage Capital Holdings’ main life insurer, which has been disputing a state regulator’s concerns about its financial strength, is seeking to defer certain payments to customers while pursuing sale talks with a potential acquirer.

top_news.title: Anthropic IPO Hands SK Hynix Tycoon’s Firm $3 Billion Windfall
top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster initial public offering has delivered a multibillion-dollar windfall for billionaire Chey Tae-won’s empire, rewarding an early bet on the artificial-intelligence startup by SK Telecom Co., South Korea’s largest mobile carrier.

top_news.title: LNG Exports Through Hormuz Appear to Slow After More Attacks
top_news.summary: The amount of liquefied natural gas tankers passing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz appears to have dropped over the last week, according to satellite and ship-tracking data, suggesting shipowners are being more cautious after a flurry of attacks.

top_news.title: Copper Rebounds After Rout as Physical Tightness Persists
top_news.summary: Copper staged a partial recovery following a steep drop on Wednesday, as traders weighed whether a sharp unwinding of bullish bets tied to artificial intelligence and US tariffs has gone too far.

top_news.title: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
top_news.summary: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.

top_news.title: Morgan Stanley’s Hornbach Says Rogue AI Biggest Underpriced Risk
top_news.summary: Artificial intelligence can bring exponential benefits but the damage that may result from a breach of its safeguards is the biggest risk that’s being underpriced by markets right now, according to Morgan Stanley.
